response.sql: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(*) AS hall_of_fame_count FROM hall_of_fame AS h JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = h.player_id WHERE h.inducted = 'Y' GROUP BY p.death_state), state_average AS (SELECT AVG(hall_of_fame_count) AS avg_count FROM state_counts) SELECT AVG(s.hall_of_fame_count) AS average_count_above_average, AVG(s.hall_of_fame_count - a.avg_count) AS average_amount_above_average FROM state_counts AS s CROSS JOIN state_average AS a WHERE s.hall_of_fame_count > a.avg_count
